code.originalText: Three-month post-fracture visit with bone density testing and zoledronic acid

text.paragraph: Three-month post-fracture review with bone density testing and zoledronic acid. [S]

Mr. Reagan returns three months after the repair of his right hip fracture. He now walks in the house and out to the garden with his walker and supervision, and enjoys sitting outside. His hip no longer hurts, even after walking, and he has had no falls. Home physical therapy continues twice a week. His caregivers give cholecalciferol every day and report no missed doses of it or of donepezil. The evening restlessness is mild and unchanged, and the evening routine still settles it. His appetite is good, and he has gained 1 kg. [S]

list.item:
Osteoporosis with right hip fragility fracture, healing (M80.051D). The fracture is clinically healing. DXA today shows a left total hip T-score of -2.8 (0.637 g/cm²) and a lumbar spine T-score of -1.9. Calcium 9.3 mg/dL, eGFR 63, and creatinine clearance about 50 mL/min allow zoledronic acid. The raised PTH and alkaline phosphatase at the first visit fit the vitamin D deficiency; alkaline phosphatase is now normal at 112. [S]
Zoledronic acid 5 mg intravenously over at least 15 minutes today, after a glass of water; his caregivers will watch for flu-like aches over the next three days.
Continue cholecalciferol 2,000 units daily and calcium from food.
Stop scheduled acetaminophen, since he has no pain.
Calcium and kidney function before the second infusion in a year.

Vitamin D deficiency, repleted (E55.9). 25-hydroxyvitamin D 36 ng/mL, up from 16. [S]
Continue cholecalciferol; recheck yearly.

Acute blood loss anemia after hip surgery, resolved (D62). Hemoglobin 13.4 g/dL, up from 11.1. [S]
Recheck hemoglobin at six months.

Dementia due to Alzheimer's disease, moderate (FAST stage 5) (F02.B0). Stable by observation and his caregivers' account. GDS-15 score 3, below the threshold for depression. Heart rate 64 on donepezil. [S]
Continue donepezil and the evening routine.
POLST form completed today with the patient taking part as he was able, reflecting the goals of care discussed in February.

History of falling (Z91.81). No falls. Walking goal met with a Barthel Index of 75. [S]
Continue home physical therapy; Timed Up and Go when therapy ends.

Immunization. No pneumococcal vaccine on record. [S]
Pneumococcal conjugate vaccine PCV20 given today.
